L2-F1 — BLOCKER — Non-condition typed-reference discovery gaps are not explicitly disclosed in the candidate evidence.
Bar violated: condition 9 (explicit unresolved discovery/adjudication limits), under ADR 0020 sections 5–7 and this lane's explicit requirement to report undisclosed discovery defects. Failed stage: relationship declaration/expansion, before ranking or context retention.

Concrete evidence: candidate record docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-11-01-o9bd-19-6-1-candidate-pack.md:49–56 discloses undeclared nested CONDITION-name leaves and their one-hop consequence, with owner eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5. That bead's disposition expressly concerns condition leaves. Existing, source-grounded, non-condition record-key links also vanish from relationship resolution/expansion without a typed outcome or loss. The 25-declaration manifest and its source packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts do not declare the following sampled shapes:

1. spell:find-familiar, records.json:166685, /mechanics/effects/0/creation/forms/0/creatureRef = creature:bat (and 14 further familiar forms, including owl at index 7). SRD p.143: "You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel." Also: "the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form". The referenced records exist, but seeding only this spell yields only this spell; bat/owl records do not enter the packet, expansion.losses = [].
2. creature:acolyte, records.json:11253, /traits/0/mechanics/spellcasting/groups/0/spells/0/ref = spell:light, and /traits/0/mechanics/spellcasting/groups/1/spells/0/ref = spell:bless (six spell refs total). 4. magic-item:hammer-of-thunderbolts, records.json:104752, /mechanics/interItem/requiresItems/0/itemRefs/0 and /1 name magic-item:belt-of-giant-strength and magic-item:gauntlets-of-ogre-power. No packet-budget exclusion caused the misses. The imposing record's own prose and ref values remain visible; the defect is neither missing source text nor invented state, but an undisclosed limitation on retrieving the related authoritative records before adjudication.

Only the four source-checked, end-to-packet misses above are promoted here as one disclosure finding.

L2-F2 — BLOCKER — Runtime shadow/intervention drops the installed relationship-manifest source, disagreeing with lookup and offline discovery.
Bar violated: condition 9 (undisclosed runtime discovery limitation); also violates the installed per-producer relationship-source contract at the runtime consumer boundary. Authority: ADR 0020 sections 4–5; RunTurnDeps.relationshipManifestSource documented as "Manifest association installed with the campaign's rules pack" at packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts:135; per-producing-pack contract in rules/recordRelationships.ts and ruleAwareness.ts. Failed stage: runtime capture input/wiring into relationship expansion.

Concrete code path: orchestrator.ts:724–736 selects the provided relationshipManifestSource and threads it into ToolContext; orchestrator.ts:870 also places it on discoveryCaptureInput. But packages/core/src/discovery/shadow.ts:178–211 ShadowDiscoveryInput has no such field, and captureRawShadow's runDiscoveryStages call at :322–331 never forwards it. packages/core/src/discovery/harness.ts:30–32 therefore substitutes bundledDnd5eSrdRecordRelationshipManifestSource(), which only knows the canonical bundled pack object. An add-on whose manifest WAS installed is falsely reported absent by the runtime discovery pass. lookup_rules correctly honors the same installed source at orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts:166–172.

Reproducer: ./node_modules/.bin/tsx /tmp/l2-runtime-source.mts. It binds the exact canonical candidate base plus one synthetic add-on containing a copy of candidate feature:barbarian:rage under feature:l2-audit-linked-feature / name "L2 Audit Linked Feature". The add-on owns a single /source record-key declaration, granted-by class:barbarian, and the same per-pack source function is supplied to lookup_rules, runDiscoveryStages, and runTurn. In-memory campaign; a scripted model returns plain narration; player names that feature; no oracle target injection.
Observed: lookup_rules reports a resolved link to class:barbarian; offline discovery reports both manifests present and includes class:barbarian in its packet. The real runTurn succeeds with discoveryMode intervene, records addon state absent, zero traversal events and no expansion losses, and injects 4,123 bytes whose delivered candidate set omits class:barbarian. Exact persisted evidence and model messages: /tmp/l2-runtime-source.json and /tmp/l2-runtime-source-messages.json. A second run in shadow mode, /tmp/l2-runtime-source-shadow.mts / .json, has the same false absent manifest and missing traversal, confirming both capture entry points share the defect.

Scope/severity: this is conditional on an installed non-default manifest source; the default bundled SRD run is not claimed broken by this reproducer. Nevertheless the campaign-pack association is an accepted live API, the failure is concretely reachable through runTurn, and neither candidate limits nor the successful runtime evidence discloses that an installed manifest was discarded. This is not a speculative future-pack robustness request or a missing universal capability.
Registry relationship: NEW runtime consumer-wiring defect; related canonical-discovery (sol:CAP-011), not recurrence of its original name-ambiguity example. The per-producer lower-level resolver protections pass; their installed source is lost before reaching them.
Suggested owner/fix: runtime discovery capture owner (shadow.ts; .19.11/.19.12 or a successor assigned by the audit consolidator). Carry RecordRelationshipManifestSource through ShadowDiscoveryInput and captureRawShadow into runDiscoveryStages, preserving the installed function by identity and its explicit absence semantics. Permanent evidence should be one generalized contract comparison across lookup/offline discovery and both runtime modes for a bound add-on with its own manifest, with an absent-manifest control; inspect the delivered packet and persisted producer state. This is proportionate to avoiding a silent live discrepancy, rather than a dedicated test for each pack/link.

LIMITS / NON-CLAIMS
The complete machine enumerations above are bounded to this candidate's emitted JSON leaves, declared relationships, and indexed name memberships. The undeclared-reference screen uses exact existing record-key equality plus reference-like suffixes; it cannot enumerate arbitrary prose references, unrecognized field semantics, non-key name leaves, paraphrases, or all situations in which a rule should matter. Its 1,398 observations are not a defect census. Packet preservation does not validate every source-prose claim against the PDF; this lane source-checked only the four F1 examples at pp.5, 143, 224, 395. Declared relationship semantic correctness was inspected by family and selected records, not by independently re-reading the source of all 514 resolved occurrences. Name tests verify positive indexed membership, not exhaustive lexical false-positive rates, every punctuation variant, or semantic retrieval. The 48 traversal checks are one resolved example per declaration and direction, not every possible seed/state composition. The two new runtime executions use one synthetic bound add-on and scripted models, not held-out/live model play or every add-on/override composition. Existing targeted tests supply additional bounded controls, not universal proof. Capability-ledger correctness, adjudication boundaries, source completeness and mutation gates belong to other lanes.

The explicitly disclosed eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5 condition-name leaves, the one-hop/two-pass bounds, and prose/model-adjudicated rules without a selected typed projection are LIMITS, not findings here. No requirement: universal typing, universal discovery, or deterministic execution of every source rule. A clean subcheck means no blocker found within that denominator, never completeness. No separate NON-BLOCKER findings are published.

LANE RESULT: BLOCKERS (2)
